title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Your top scorer
hook: One player scores most of your team's goals.
intro: Teammates pass to them every time.
The other players stop trying to score.
statement: A star player can lift a team or flatten it.
q1: Do you ask your top scorer to set others up —
q2: or let them keep scoring while they can?
q3: What do the other players need to grow?
t1: Every team is different. But teams grow
t2: when the best player helps others shine.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle a top scorer?
ctaLines: Assist goals count double. New role. Let them score.
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
One player scores most of your team's goals.
Teammates pass to them every time. The other players stop trying to score.
A star player can lift a team or flatten it.
Ask them to share or let them score. Both can work.
How do you handle a top scorer? Share your habit in the comments.
